subject: Vendor re-entry playbook and PO surcharge negotiation
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor re-entry playbook + PO surcharge — next steps

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. Per our conversation, we put together a short vendor re-entry playbook that outlines the onboarding refresh steps, expected evidence, and a recommended PO flow when customers need a short-term surcharge to bridge capacity while procurement completes the PO. I attached the playbook (MD) and a draft SOW with the incremental capacity line item.

Quick summary / asks:
- Can you confirm which procurement contact will review the PO template? (Marco or someone else?)
- Are EdgeHealth's controls ok with Redwood's proposed evidence bundle (SOC 2 summary + restricted-access logs)?
- If you need a formal amendment instead of a one-off PO surcharge, let us know and we can push a revised SOW.

Proposed timeline:
1) Procurement review of PO template — by EOD Wed 8/26
2) Evidence upload to your portal / Drive — by Fri 8/28
3) Interim surcharge activation (if agreed) — target Mon 8/31

If helpful, Ben can walk Marco/finance through the PO template in a 20‑minute call.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: vendor-reentry-playbook.md (text), SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@edgehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor re-entry playbook + PO surcharge — next steps

Thanks Camila — appreciate the concise playbook. Looping in Marco (cc'd below) who owns contracts/PO at EdgeHealth. A few quick notes:

- Marco will review the PO template; he asked for the line item to explicitly state the surcharge is temporary and the exact hours/GB or token bands it covers.
- Our security team said SOC 2 summary + audit contact is fine for the short-term re-entry; they still want the audit logs retained in our portal for 90 days.
- On the SOW: pricing needs a separate appendix for the surcharge rates and an automatic sunset clause by date or by PO exhaustion.

We can target the timeline but need a short call between Ben and Marco to align on the PO columns. How's Thu 8/27 10:00am PT for a 20-minute run-through?

Best,
Sara
Sara Liu
Sr. Procurement Manager | EdgeHealth
sara.liu@edgehealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@edgehealth.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor re-entry playbook + PO surcharge — quick call and sample numbers

Hi Marco / Sara — Ben here, Camila looped me in to run through the PO template.

Thanks for the ask on explicit surcharge language. For the call I prepared three example surcharge bands (included below) so procurement has a clear mapping to usage:

- Band A: +20% capacity (up to 50k tokens/day) — surcharge $0.012/token — sunset: 30 days or PO exhaustion
- Band B: +50% capacity (up to 150k tokens/day) — surcharge $0.010/token — sunset: 45 days or PO exhaustion
- Band C: +100% capacity (up to 300k tokens/day) — surcharge $0.0085/token — sunset: 60 days or PO exhaustion

We can move the surcharge appendix into the SOW as an explicit amendment and add a capture table in the PO template that lists: start date, end date, band chosen, estimated spend cap, and invoicing cadence.

Call confirmed Thu 8/27 10:00am PT — Dial-in: +1-650-555-0123, Meeting link: https://zoom.us/j/123456789

Looking forward — will share the Excel PO prefilled after the call.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: EdgeHealth_PO_template.xlsx (Excel stub)
From: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@edgehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor re-entry playbook + PO surcharge — approval path

Ben / Camila / Sara — following our call, procurement reviewed the example bands and the language. We're prepared to approve Band B (50% capacity) with the following conditions:

- PO must include an explicit sunset date (we agreed 45 days).
- Redwood to upload the evidence bundle to our portal (SOC 2 summary, audit contact, and first 14 days of logs) by tomorrow 8/32. [Note: typo in date, meant 9/01]
- Finance needs the final SOW with the surcharge appendix and an invoice schedule (monthly) attached to the PO before we issue.

I'll route a signed PO as soon as Laura from finance signs off. If you can send the updated SOW and the prefilled PO spreadsheet today, I'll fast-track it on our side.

Marco Rossi
Procurement Director | EdgeHealth
marco.rossi@edgehealth.com
